data.title: Pension account clarification: study period not credited
data.summary: The pension insurer (Muster-Rentenversicherung Bund) wrote on 27 November 2025 confirming your insurance history for periods older than six calendar years. Your studies from 1 October 2008 to 30 September 2011 were not credited because proof of graduation is missing.
data.explanation: This is a decision (Bescheid) that makes the older periods in your insurance history binding. Your study period was not recorded as a credited period (Anrechnungszeit) because no degree certificate was provided. If you disagree, for example because you can prove your graduation, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or record it at the insurer. The app shows the deadline. Filing at another domestic authority or social benefit provider in time also counts. Check the attached insurance history carefully. Consider getting advice from a pension advisor if unsure.

key_facts.label: Study period not credited (Studium)
key_facts.quote: Die Zeit Ihres Studiums vom 01.10.2008 bis 30.09.2011 kann nicht als Anrechnungszeit vorgemerkt werden, da der Studienabschluss nicht nachgewiesen wurde (§ 58 Abs. 1 Nr. 4 SGB VI).

key_facts.label: Reason (Begründung)
key_facts.quote: Die Zeit Ihres Studiums vom 01.10.2008 bis 30.09.2011 kann nicht als Anrechnungszeit vorgemerkt werden, da der Studienabschluss nicht nachgewiesen wurde (§ 58 Abs. 1 Nr. 4 SGB VI).

items.action: If you disagree, for example because you can prove your graduation, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or for the record with the insurer.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes binding and the study period stays uncredited.
